functions.name: open_url
functions.signature: open_url(const std::string &url, bool insecure=false, const std::string &ca_file="")
functions.brief: Open a secure WebSocket connection from a wss://host[:port]/path URL and return it as an owning Client (the RAII, with-friendly form of connect_url()).

params.name: insecure
params.desc: skip certificate validation (pinned/controlled peer only). Default false.

params.name: ca_file
params.desc: a PEM CA bundle to trust instead of the system store (empty = system default).

functions.name: x25519
functions.brief: The X25519 function: scalar-multiply point_hex (a u-coordinate) by scalar_hex.
functions.returns: the 32-byte result as 64-char hex, or "" on malformed input or an all-zero result (a contributory-behaviour check: a zero shared secret is REJECTED).

functions.name: x25519_base
functions.brief: The base-point form: derive the public key for scalar_hex (u = 9).
functions.returns: the public key as 64-char hex, or "" on malformed input.
